way.en: Can you tell me the way to the train station, please?
way.cn: 请问去火车站的路怎么走？

turn.en: Turn right at the second crossroads.

left.en: The bookstore is on the left, next to the bank.

right.en: After the bridge, the museum is on the right side.
right.cn: 过桥后博物馆就在右边。

straight.en: Walk straight for five minutes and you'll see the park.
straight.cn: 直走五分钟就能看到公园。

crossroads.en: There is a hospital at the next crossroads.
crossroads.cn: 下个十字路口有家医院。

map.en: I use my phone map when I travel to a new city.
map.cn: 去新城市我用手机地图。

lost.en: If you get lost, ask a police officer for help.
